organization.name: ZKNOX
organization.summary: Paris-based hardware security and cryptography company working on hardware wallet applications, post-quantum signature EIPs and zero-knowledge circuits. Its website lists three people and partners including Railgun and the Ethereum Foundation. The GitHub organization holds 50 public repositories (12 sampled, none forks or archived) with pushes through 2026-11-28.

The proposal states other funding for this work: none

claims.claim: ZKlarity: a clear-signing circuit for 13 Aave v3 actions and a Groth16 verifier running natively in a Ledger Nano S+, 2.8 s per verification.
claims.method: The repository exists (created 2026-02-27, last push 2026-03-23, 5 stars) and the blog post describes the work. The README lists four Aave actions, not 13, and no device run or timing was reproduced.
GitHub API shows 50 public repositories in the organization, with pushes as recent as 2026-11-28.
All three EIP pages resolve. Their author fields were not extracted, so authorship by ZKNOX members was not confirmed. The ZKNOX EIPs page names EIP-8051 and EIP-8052 as its own.

claims.claim: ZKNOX won first prize in the Ledger track at ETHGlobal Cannes 2026 with ZKlarity.
claims.method: ZKNOX lists ZKLARITY (ETHGlobal Cannes 2026) but does not name a prize. The ETHGlobal showcase returned a browser challenge page and could not be read.

claims.claim: Founders include a Ledger co-founder and former CTO.
claims.method: The team page states it for Nicolas Bacca. No independent Ledger source was checked.

claims.claim: Verifier v1.0 runs on Nano S+, Nano X, Stax and Flex within 3.0 s (BLS12-381) and 2.5 s (BN254); the Ledger app ships in its catalog; the Kohaku integration is merged.
claims.method: These are future milestones and none is marked done. No Ledger app listing or merged Kohaku pull request for this work was found.

claims.claim: Independent review report with 0 open high or critical findings, and 5 protocols publishing rules on-chain, will be delivered.
claims.method: These are future milestones. No review report or onchain rules record was found.

claims.claim: ZKNOX audited Railgun PPOI and Privacy Pools deposits and contributed to Railgun's curve library.
claims.method: No public audit report for either was located. ZKNoxHQ has Railgun-related repositories (for example rsgun-wallet), which do not show an audit.
